name: Karaloki
source:
Join Karaloki, everyone's favourite chaotic vtuber as they enlist you, yes you, to aid them in their quest to discover more about the world. A companion piece to the Pastel Jam Game Entry, MellowDi, this game is the complete opposite... and we mean...the complete opposite.

Watch as this chaotic and unstable entity learns more about a very special member of their stream audience... Join them both as they discover what it is to be their true selves. 

[from [url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/karaloki]Itch.io[/url]]
